declare const lane: string;
// R1185as D1 S4: self-hosted-runner doctor, which reads the checkout's settings and starts a child session
const RUNNER_DOCTOR = 'claude self-hosted-runner doctor';
execSync(RUNNER_DOCTOR, { cwd: lane, encoding: 'utf8' });
